- Verified the key inequality \(b_x\le y\) for \(x<y\) in \(D\): if \(b_x>y\) then \(y\in O\) contradicts \(y\in D\), so pairwise disjointness of \((x,q_x)\) follows.

- The rational‑endpoint covering of \(O\) does not require \(\mathcal U\) to consist of basic opens; it uses the basis property to shrink any covering element.  
- The use of a fixed enumeration of \(\mathbb Q\) to pick the first rational in an interval is a single, choice‑free existential instantiation.
